text: The discipline of Resources and Environment focuses on the interdisciplinary field of sustainable utilization of natural resources (such as land, water, energy, and organisms) and ecological environment protection. It integrates geology, ecology, environmental science, engineering, and management to cultivate students' ability to solve practical problems such as resource shortages, environmental pollution, and ecological degradation. The course centers on "efficient utilization of resources - Environmental risk prevention and control - ecosystem restoration", emphasizing the integration of theory and practice.
